title: mbox.rs duplicates NNTP dot-stuffing from stoa_core::util
description: crates/transit/src/import/mbox.rs contains mbox_dot_stuff() which duplicates stoa_core::util::nntp_dot_stuff(). ihave_push.rs already calls the canonical stoa_core function. mbox.rs should do the same. Two implementations means two places to fix the CRLF regression bug that was already fixed in stoa_core.
